clue.text: Recall with reference to one's business

parts.note: RE is the Latin-derived word meaning about or concerning, as in business letters
a vocation is a person's calling or occupation

explanation.surface: A memory of something to do with someone's line of work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recall' looks like a verb about memory, but here it is the noun for cancelling or withdrawing something, as in recalling a decree.
explanation.definitionFit: A revocation is the official withdrawal or cancelling of an order, which is one meaning of a recall.

clue.text: Healthy old boy in brown coat

indicators.note: the old boy is placed inside the coat, so the word in signals one piece sitting within another

parts.note: rust is the brown coating that forms on iron
OB is the standard abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil of a school

explanation.surface: A fit former schoolboy wearing a brown overcoat.
explanation.definitionFit: Robust describes someone strong and in good physical condition, a synonym of healthy.

clue.text: Flower girl

definitions.meaning: a woman's first name, also that of the bloom

explanation.definitionFit: The violet is a small purple bloom, and Violet is also a female first name.

clue.text: Bringing into force

parts.note: reads like putting a law into effect, but means drafting people into the armed forces

explanation.definitionFit: Conscription is compulsory enlistment into the military, so it brings people into the forces.

clue.text: In and out of the sea

definitions.text: In and out of the sea

parts.words: In and out of the sea
parts.note: describes the water that flows towards the shore and back again twice a day

explanation.definitionFit: The tide is the regular rise and fall of the ocean, coming in and going out.

clue.text: No calls can be received out of trouble?

definitions.meaning: describes a telephone receiver lifted from its cradle so the line is engaged
freed from a difficulty or obligation

explanation.definitionFit: A phone left with its handset lifted cannot ring, and someone let go from blame or duty has escaped trouble.

clue.text: Drivers' organisation caught in official proceedings

indicators.note: the abbreviation for caught is placed inside the motoring body, so in signals containment

parts.note: the AA is the Automobile Association, a British motoring club offering breakdown help

explanation.surface: Motoring club members are arrested at a formal hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Acta is the Latin term for recorded transactions or minutes of formal meetings.

clue.text: Amorous person about to take eggs round hospital

indicators.note: the pair formed by about and eggs goes round the hospital, so round signals one piece enclosing another

parts.note: CA is short for circa, Latin for around, used before dates
ova is the Latin plural for egg cells
SAN is short for sanatorium, a kind of hospital

explanation.surface: A romantic is about to carry eggs around a hospital ward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' makes the about-plus-eggs pair enclose the hospital; 'to take' is only a link. SAN, for sanatorium, is an old crossword shorthand for a hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: Casanova was an eighteenth-century Venetian famous for his many love affairs, so his name stands for a womaniser.

clue.text: A strange flower, the cuckoo-pint

parts.note: rum is an old British word meaning odd or peculiar
a lily is a trumpet-shaped bloom

explanation.surface: An odd bloom, the woodland plant known as cuckoo-pint.
explanation.definitionFit: Cuckoo-pint is a British country name for the wild arum, a hooded woodland plant.

clue.text: Fed up when suntanned perhaps

definitions.meaning: bored and annoyed, a British idiom
describes skin turned dark by the sun, read literally

explanation.definitionFit: Browned off is British slang for disgruntled, and someone tanned by the sun has literally been browned.

clue.text: In the good book he's found in section before Saul

indicators.note: the answer is found within a section of the words that follow, a stretch of the phrase before Saul

explanation.surface: A biblical character appears in the part of scripture that precedes Saul.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters sit inside 'beforE SAUl'; neatly, this man's story in Genesis does come before Saul's in Samuel.
explanation.definitionFit: Esau is Jacob's elder brother in Genesis, a man named in the Bible, which is called the good book.

clue.text: Recent danger coming from place where plants are sold

indicators.note: the answer comes from the words recent danger rearranged, so coming from signals the new order

explanation.surface: A recent hazard has arisen at a nursery shop.
explanation.definitionFit: A garden centre is a retail outlet stocking shrubs, seeds and gardening supplies.

clue.text: Old bob had fish with unpleasant smell

parts.note: a bob was an old British shilling, abbreviated S before decimal currency
a tench is a freshwater fish of the carp family

explanation.surface: An old shilling bought a fish that smelled bad.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'bob' was slang for the pre-1971 British shilling, written s.
explanation.definitionFit: A stench is a strong foul odour, so it is an unpleasant smell.

clue.text: Her plans ruined by little bits of shell

indicators.note: her plans being wrecked tells us the letters of those words are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman's schemes are wrecked by fragments of an exploding shell.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrapnel is the metal fragments thrown out when an artillery shell bursts.

clue.text: Award last month's speech

parts.note: December is the final month of the year, abbreviated DEC
an oration is a formal public speech

explanation.surface: A medal is presented at a December ceremony with a speech.
explanation.definitionFit: A decoration is a medal or honour conferred on someone, so it is an award.

clue.text: Similar to nick who is very fast

parts.note: like means resembling or similar to
Old Nick is a traditional name for Satan

explanation.surface: Someone who resembles a thief is moving at great speed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nick' looks like a verb for stealing, but it is the nickname Old Nick for Satan.
explanation.definitionFit: Like the devil is an idiom meaning with great speed or energy.

clue.text: Full of beans — and whisky?

definitions.meaning: read as an example of a spirit, so containing liquor

explanation.definitionFit: Spirited means lively and energetic, and read as spirit plus -ed it suggests laced with strong liquor such as whisky.

clue.text: Get off one's high horse perhaps

definitions.text: Get off one's high horse perhaps

parts.words: Get off one's high horse perhaps
parts.note: the idiom for stopping being arrogant is read literally as climbing down from a tall steed

explanation.definitionFit: To dismount is to climb down from a horse or bicycle, which literally describes getting off a high horse.

clue.text: Indicate exact place for race

definitions.meaning: show precisely where something is, step by step
a cross-country steeplechase for amateur riders

explanation.definitionFit: A point-to-point is a British amateur horse race over fences, and the phrase can also mean directing precisely from one spot to the next.

clue.text: Occasion when one would not be expected to be found out?

definitions.text: Occasion when one would not be expected to be found out?

parts.words: Occasion when one would not be expected to be found out?
parts.note: describes a social reception where the host is present indoors, not away from the house

explanation.definitionFit: An at-home is a party held in one's own house, when the host is in rather than out.

clue.text: Put money into underwear

parts.note: in is a short form of into
a vest is a British undergarment worn under a shirt

explanation.surface: Someone stuffs cash into their undershirt for safekeeping.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a 'vest' is a sleeveless undershirt, not a waistcoat.
explanation.definitionFit: To invest is to commit funds in the hope of profit, that is to put money somewhere.

clue.text: Lex

parts.note: the Latin word for law, so read as the legal system of ancient Rome

explanation.definitionFit: Lex is Latin for law, so the word denotes the legal code of the Romans.

clue.text: Sacristan attacked ten inside

indicators.note: the Roman numeral for ten goes inside the phrase meaning attacked

parts.note: set on means assaulted or attacked
X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: A church officer was assaulted by ten people indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: A sexton is a church officer who looks after the building and its contents, like a sacristan.

clue.text: Paltry design

explanation.definitionFit: Mean can describe something meagre or stingy, and to mean something is to intend or purpose it.

clue.text: Their leader received embrace from ruffian

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its opening letter, here that of their

parts.note: a hug is an embrace

explanation.surface: A gang boss was greeted with a hug from a thug.
explanation.definitionFit: A thug is a violent, rough person, a synonym of ruffian.

clue.text: Re-mentions variety of soup

indicators.note: a variety of the letters means they appear in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone keeps bringing up different kinds of soup.
explanation.definitionFit: Minestrone is a thick Italian vegetable soup often containing pasta.

clue.text: Take out fruit

definitions.meaning: go on a romantic outing with someone
a sweet brown fruit from a palm tree

explanation.definitionFit: To date someone is to take them out romantically, and a date is the fruit of a palm.

clue.text: No matter what happens during whichever item in sports contest

parts.note: in means during, as in in the morning
any means whichever one
an event is one competition within a sports meeting

explanation.surface: Something happens during one of the contests at an athletics meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: In any event is an idiom meaning regardless or whatever the outcome.
